subject.title: feat(onboard): streamline setup with agent-assisted configuration

question: Should installed official channels that pass strict ledger, current-path, package, plugin-id, and official-source checks inherit repository-owned catalog labels and docs paths?
rationale: Tests establish identity and fail-closed mechanics, but maintainers must authorize the permanent boundary for consuming trusted official metadata from installed external plugins.

options.title: Accept strict re-linking
options.body: Permit repository-owned metadata only when every path, identity, and provenance check succeeds.

options.title: Keep catalog-only metadata
options.body: Expose verified docs metadata only for bundled and not-yet-installed official catalog entries.

recommendation.title: Accept strict re-linking
recommendation.body: Permit repository-owned metadata only when every path, identity, and provenance check succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged history connects this person to both official external plugin trust and canonical onboarding product direction.
